verdict.rationale: v0's own platform docs say the API gives programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities, naming code generation, chat, project management and deployment. GitHub imports, export, file-based starts and custom chat UIs are also documented, and the official SDK shows chats being created programmatically. However, parity is asserted rather than shown feature by feature: UI-specific functions such as visual controls, design-system styles, Fix Build/Fix CI and branch duplication are not documented as API endpoints. Missing for 10: per-feature evidence of API parity for visual editing, design systems, deployment-fix and branch workflows, and independent or hands-on confirmation that nothing is UI-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The v0 API gives you programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities, letting you integrate v0's AI-powered code generation, chat interface, project management, and deployment features into your own applications and workflows.
